limitations: Exact static upright/yaw boot boxes only; no angular sweep or dynamic obstacle lifecycle.
A conservative enclosing-prism no-fit can reject a space that the four separate modules might fit; accepted targets must still pass exact module SAT.
Support clipping uses unexpanded actual tread dimensions; 1.5mm safety skin belongs to obstacle clearance, not extra support area.
The inherited0.5mm top tolerance intentionally permits a0.4mm higher micro-surface to be ignored. That tolerance case is not a strict1micrometre zero-volume pass.
